lyrics.ja: Blue
lyrics.en: Blue
lyrics.zh: Blue

lyrics.ja: 午前0時の帳(とばり)の街を
lyrics.romaji: Gozen Reiji no Tobari no Machi wo
lyrics.en: The city under the midnight curtain
lyrics.zh: 午夜零時帷幕下的城市

lyrics.ja: 独り占めしてる気分
lyrics.en: I feel like I have it all to myself
lyrics.zh: 有種獨佔了一切的心情

lyrics.ja: 散らばった　ビル灯り
lyrics.en: Scattered building lights
lyrics.zh: 散落的建築燈火

lyrics.ja: 失ったものばかりが　煌めいてる
lyrics.en: Only the things I've lost are sparkling
lyrics.zh: 失去的事物，都在閃閃發光

lyrics.ja: 目を閉じて　踊ろう
lyrics.en: Close your eyes and let's dance
lyrics.zh: 閉上眼睛起舞吧

lyrics.ja: さよならで　終われないし
lyrics.en: I can't end it with goodbye
lyrics.zh: 不能以再見作結

lyrics.ja: 永遠の夜なんてないのは　わかってる
lyrics.romaji: Eien no Yoru Nante Nai no ha Wakatteru
lyrics.en: I know there's no such thing as an eternal night
lyrics.zh: 我知道沒有所謂永遠的夜晚

lyrics.ja: だから　そう　君と明かす夜がいい
lyrics.romaji: Dakara Sou Kimi to Akasu Yoru ga Ii
lyrics.en: So, yes—I want a night spent with you
lyrics.zh: 所以，對，我想和你共度夜晚

lyrics.ja: 明日もまた同じ　朝日が昇るなら
lyrics.romaji: Ashita mo Mata Onaji Asahi ga Noboru Nara
lyrics.en: If the same morning sun rises again tomorrow
lyrics.zh: 若明天又升起同樣的朝陽

lyrics.ja: もう...　何(なん)もいらない
lyrics.en: Then... I need nothing else
lyrics.zh: 那麼……我什麼都不需要了

lyrics.ja: 青く光る夜が　星空のミラーボール
lyrics.romaji: Aoku Hikaru Yoru ga Hoshizora no Miraa Booru
lyrics.en: The blue-glowing night is a mirror ball of stars
lyrics.zh: 藍光閃爍的夜，是星空的鏡球

lyrics.ja: さぁ...　私を照らして
lyrics.en: Now... shine on me
lyrics.zh: 來吧……照亮我

lyrics.ja: タップで地球　揺らすくらい
lyrics.en: Enough to shake the earth with a tap
lyrics.zh: 用踢踏舞震動地球般

lyrics.ja: ここで踊り明かそう
lyrics.en: Let's dance the night away right here
lyrics.zh: 就在這裡跳舞到天明

lyrics.ja: 午前5時の　夜明けの街で
lyrics.romaji: Gozen Goji no Yoake no Machi de
lyrics.en: In the dawn city at 5 a.m.
lyrics.zh: 凌晨五點，黎明時分的城市

lyrics.ja: なんか　独りぼっちな気分
lyrics.en: Somehow, I feel all alone
lyrics.zh: 總覺得孤單一人

lyrics.ja: 薄まってゆく　パレット
lyrics.en: A palette that's fading out
lyrics.zh: 逐漸淡去的調色盤

lyrics.ja: ぼんやり眺める　ベッドで　期待してる
lyrics.romaji: Bonyari Nagameru Beddo de Kitai Shiteru
lyrics.en: Lying in bed, gazing absently, I'm waiting
lyrics.zh: 在床上發呆眺望，滿心期待

lyrics.ja: 君の足音を
lyrics.en: For your footsteps
lyrics.zh: 你的腳步聲

lyrics.ja: 触れたくても　触れられないし
lyrics.en: Even if I want to touch, I can't
lyrics.zh: 想觸碰卻觸碰不到

lyrics.ja: 運命の赤い糸なんて　知らないし
lyrics.romaji: Unmei no Akai Ito Nante Shiranai shi
lyrics.en: And I don't know anything about a red string of fate
lyrics.zh: 也不懂什麼命運的紅線

lyrics.ja: それでも君と　繋がっていたい
lyrics.romaji: Sore demo Kimi to Tsunagatte Itai
lyrics.en: Even so, I want to stay connected to you
lyrics.zh: 即使如此，還是想與你相繫

lyrics.ja: 明るくなる空に　この想い乗せても
lyrics.romaji: Akaruku Naru Sora ni Kono Omoi Nosete mo
lyrics.en: Even if I put these feelings on the brightening sky
lyrics.zh: 就算將這份心意寄託漸亮的天空

lyrics.ja: もう...　何(なん)も見えない
lyrics.en: I can't see anything anymore...
lyrics.zh: 卻……什麼也看不見

lyrics.ja: 灰色に流れる　雲間から差し込む
lyrics.romaji: Haiiro ni Nagareru Kumoma kara Sashikomu
lyrics.en: Streaming through gaps in the drifting gray clouds
lyrics.zh: 從灰暗流動的雲縫間灑落

lyrics.ja: あぁ...　他人事な顔
lyrics.en: Ah... with an indifferent face
lyrics.zh: 啊啊……一副事不關己的表情

lyrics.ja: たっぷり　深呼吸して
lyrics.en: Take a deep, deep breath
lyrics.zh: 深吸一口氣

lyrics.ja: 境界線を越える
lyrics.en: And cross the boundary
lyrics.zh: 跨越界線

lyrics.ja: 世界の中心　一番見える場所
lyrics.romaji: Sekai no Chuushin Ichiban Mieru Basho
lyrics.en: At the center of the world, where I can see it best
lyrics.zh: 在世界中心，視野最好的地方

lyrics.ja: 裸足で踊る
lyrics.en: I dance barefoot
lyrics.zh: 光著腳跳舞

lyrics.ja: 夜空が周り　キラキラ光るの
lyrics.romaji: Yozora ga Mawari Kira Kira Hikaru no
lyrics.en: The night sky spins around, glittering
lyrics.zh: 夜空環繞，閃閃發光

lyrics.ja: ねぇ早く気付いて　エスコートして
lyrics.en: Hey, hurry up and notice—escort me
lyrics.zh: 吶，快點發現，來護送我

lyrics.ja: 明日もまた同じ　朝日が昇るなら
lyrics.romaji: Ashita mo Mata Onaji Asahi ga Noboru Nara
lyrics.en: If the same morning sun rises again tomorrow
lyrics.zh: 若明天又升起同樣的朝陽

lyrics.ja: もう...　何(なん)もいらない
lyrics.en: Then... I need nothing else
lyrics.zh: 那麼……我什麼都不需要了

lyrics.ja: 青く光る夜が　星空のミラーボール
lyrics.romaji: Aoku Hikaru Yoru ga Hoshizora no Miraa Booru
lyrics.en: The blue-glowing night is a mirror ball of stars
lyrics.zh: 藍光閃爍的夜，是星空的鏡球

lyrics.ja: さぁ...　私を照らして
lyrics.en: Now... shine on me
lyrics.zh: 來吧……照亮我

lyrics.ja: タップで地球　揺らすくらい
lyrics.en: Enough to shake the earth with a tap
lyrics.zh: 用踢踏舞震動地球般

lyrics.ja: ここで踊り明かそう
lyrics.en: Let's dance the night away right here
lyrics.zh: 就在這裡跳舞到天明
